Exam and assessment lab retirement

Why exams and assessment labs are retired

Technology changes faster every year. We retire credentials that are no longer relevant.

What to expect when an exam or assessment lab is retired

If you’re currently preparing for an exam that will be retired, take it before the retirement date.
